name: Heads-Up No-Limit Texas Hold'em Poker Benchmark
description: A benchmark for evaluating agents in heads-up no-limit Texas Hold'em poker, a partially observable, strategic two-player imperfect-information game with betting, bluffing, and opponent modeling.
evaluation_method: Tournament results, win rate, chip EV, and performance against fixed or held-out opponents/bots
typical_sota_score: Varies substantially by opponent pool; strong agents can achieve positive EV against many benchmark opponents, but no single canonical score exists
notes: Open-ended benchmark with imperfect information and strong dependence on opponent strategy, randomness, and evaluation protocol.
